# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.1

- Added `minClientVersions.sandMobile: "never"`. Intercom sign-in almost never finishes from Grok Bot's mobile app, so the mobile app no longer lists the plugin until that is fixed. Desktop is unchanged.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Logo: Intercom brand mark on a white tile (Intercom blue `#1F8FFF`).
- Added the `intercom` MCP server pointing at `https://mcp.intercom.com/mcp`.
